title: isComputedPlaceholder is duplicated verbatim between StepCard and CalculationHero
description: `function isComputedPlaceholder(value: string | undefined): boolean { return value?.trim().toLowerCase() === "computed" }` is defined identically in StepCard.tsx (36-38) and CalculationHero.tsx (59-61). Both modules live in frontend/src/trace and both consume the same trace 'computed' placeholder sentinel. Extracting it to a shared trace util (e.g. alongside traceFormatting.ts) and importing it in both places removes the copy and keeps the placeholder semantics in one place.
evidence: StepCard.tsx:36-38 and CalculationHero.tsx:59-61 contain byte-identical implementations; grep for 'isComputedPlaceholder' returns exactly these two definitions.
behavior_preservation: Behavior-identical: same pure predicate referenced from a shared location; no call-site semantics change.
